classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Design 1-2 compact binder candidates against a user-supplied target PDB, evaluate interface quality with ipSAE, and rank results.
assumptions: Target PDB is supplied at runtime via params.target_pdb; chain A is the default target chain.
BindCraft assigns the binder to chain B in the predicted complex output.
Two trajectory shards (seeds 42 and 137) run in parallel at max_parallel 2 to match the tool default GPU budget.
num_designs is set to 1 per shard (recommended_shard_size 1) to keep each trajectory short and outputs concrete.
num_recycles is kept at 1 for speed; filter_mode default preserves upstream BindCraft quality thresholds.
No target hotspot residues are provided; BindCraft performs an unconstrained interface search across the target surface.
ipSAE default cutoffs (10 Å) are used for interface residue detection on both chain pairs.
rank_designs aggregates both shard outputs and returns the top-2 candidates by composite interface score.
submit_candidate is excluded from this plan; final submission is a post-round decision made after reviewing actual outputs.
missing_inputs: target_pdb: path to the target PDB file must be provided before execution.

success_criteria.designs_produced: at least 1 BindCraft design PDB per trajectory shard
success_criteria.ipsae_evaluated: ipSAE interface confidence score computed for each design
success_criteria.ranked_output: rank_designs returns top-2 candidates ordered by composite interface score
